notes.subject: Ruben
notes.rationale: direct reproach addressed to Reuben: 'Long wanem as yu sindaun nating?'

notes.subject: שרקות עדרים
notes.rationale: 'whistling/piping for the flocks' (shepherd's call, JPS) vs 'bleatings of the flocks' (KJV) — whose sound is heard?

notes.subject: שרקות
notes.rationale: שרוקה occurs only here in the Tanakh.

notes.subject: חקקי לב / חקרי לב
notes.rationale: v15 'decrees of heart' vs v16 'searchings of heart' — near-identical sound contrast, resolved vs unresolved deliberation; lost in Tok Pisin.

translation: Long wanem as yu sindaun nating namel long ol tu-pela banis bilong ol sipsip, long harim ol man i kruk singautim olgeta flok bilong ol sipsip na meme? Long ol hap bilong Ruben, ol i painim aut tingting bilong bel olgeta.
